facts.text: Western Illinois University offers a guaranteed four-year rate for tuition, becoming the first university in Illinois to offer this guarantee.

sources.title: Tuition Guarantee - WIU
sources.quote: Western Illinois University ensures that your college years will be a good investment with its guaranteed four-year rate for tuition.

sources.title: Tuition Guarantee - WIU
sources.quote: Western was the first university in Illinois to offer this guarantee.
